params.body:
**Triage proposal** (from the forwarded mail; change the labels if it is wrong)
Category: question  Priority: P3
Summary: After changing a garage's Car-Pass password, the field shows fewer dots than the password has characters; the user asks whether the password was saved.

Source: Portal mail:8.

## The question

A user updated the Car-Pass password in a garage's settings (Car-Pass tab). Afterwards a Car-Pass was successfully created for that garage, so the new password works, but the field shows fewer dots than the password has characters, which made them doubt it was saved.

## Answer

This is by design. Since 2026-09-13 the password is stored encrypted and never sent back to the browser (`resources/views/settings/dealer/_tabs/carpass.blade.php`): the input is always empty, and the eight dots are a fixed placeholder that only says *a* password is stored, together with the "Wachtwoord ingesteld" marker. Leaving the field empty on save keeps the stored password.

Possible follow-up, only if wanted: make the hint say explicitly that the dots do not reflect the length of the password.
params.title: Car-Pass password field shows fewer dots than the password has characters: is it saved?
